name: Ivory Tee & Beige Trousers
colourName: ivory cotton tee with beige high-waist tailored trousers
description: A fitted ivory tee tucked into high-waist pressed trousers with white sneakers. Clean, modern and right for almost any day.
accessories: Small gold studs, a structured tote
tip: Keep the tee fitted and fully tucked so the high waist of the trousers shows.

name: Banarasi Silk Saree
colourName: deep wine red silk with heavy gold zari
description: A handwoven heirloom silk from Varanasi with dense gold brocade. The classic choice for weddings and big festivals.
pieces: Banarasi silk saree with gold zari border
Gold brocade blouse with elbow sleeves
footwear: Gold embellished juttis or block heels
accessories: Temple jewellery, jhumkas, gajra around the bun
tip: Let the zari border be the star. Keep the blouse in a matching tone and stick to gold jewellery.

name: Kanjeevaram Silk Saree
colourName: emerald green silk with a contrasting magenta and gold border
description: Heavy mulberry silk woven in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu, famous for bold contrasting borders.
pieces: Kanjeevaram silk saree with contrast border
accessories: Kasu mala or temple necklace, jhumkas, jasmine in the braid
tip: Contrast is the point: pick the blouse in the border colour, not the body colour.

name: Sequin Chiffon Party Saree
colourName: blush pink chiffon covered in silver sequins
description: Lightweight chiffon or georgette with all-over sequins. Drapes close to the body and sparkles under lights.
accessories: Statement diamond-look earrings, no necklace, a clutch
tip: Pin the pleats tightly and keep the pallu narrow so the shimmer reads as a line.

name: Pre-draped Ruffle Saree
colourName: lavender georgette with layered ruffles
description: A ready-stitched saree with ruffle tiers. Zip in and go: no pleating skills needed and easy to dance in.
accessories: Ear cuffs, a cocktail ring, a potli bag
tip: Ruffles add volume, so keep hair sleek and jewellery minimal.

name: Handloom Cotton Saree
colourName: indigo block-printed cotton with an ivory blouse
description: Breathable handloom cotton (think ikat, jamdani or dabu prints). Elegant enough for work, comfortable all day.
accessories: Oxidised silver jhumkas, a watch, a jute tote
tip: Starch the saree lightly before draping so the pleats stay crisp till evening.

name: Bridal Lehenga
colourName: bridal red velvet and silk with gold zardozi embroidery
description: The full bridal look: heavy flared skirt, fitted blouse and a sheer embroidered dupatta, usually in red or deep pink.
pieces: Embroidered red lehenga skirt with can-can
Net dupatta with scalloped gold border
accessories: Choker and rani haar, maang tikka, nath, chooda and kaleere
tip: Do a trial: the skirt alone can weigh 5 to 10 kg, so choose a can-can and footwear you can stand in for hours.

name: Pastel Mirror-work Lehenga
colourName: mint green with peach and pink mirror work
description: Light pastel lehenga with tiny mirror and thread work. Fresh for daytime functions and easy to move in.
accessories: Floral or kundan jewellery, haath phool
tip: Pastels photograph best in daylight. Add one deeper accent, like pink, so you do not look washed out.

name: Navratri Chaniya Choli
colourName: red, marigold and teal with mirror work
description: The Gujarati garba outfit: a wide twirling skirt with mirrors, a backless choli and a bright odhni.
footwear: Barefoot for garba or flat mojaris
accessories: Oxidised silver jewellery, kamarbandh, ghungroo anklets
tip: Pick a skirt with at least 6 to 8 metres of flare. That is what makes the twirl.

name: Floor-length Anarkali
colourName: royal blue with gold embroidery
description: A fitted bodice that flares into a floor-length frock. Mughal in origin, regal and flattering on almost everyone.
tip: Let the flare start at your natural waist to make the most of the shape.

name: Chikankari Kurta Set
colourName: ivory white with tonal chikankari embroidery
description: Hand-embroidered white-on-white work from Lucknow. Cool, graceful and works from office to family lunch.
accessories: Pearl or silver studs, a slim bangle
tip: Wear a nude slip underneath: fine mulmul is sheer.

name: Block-print Kurta & Palazzo
colourName: mustard yellow with teal block print and off-white palazzos
description: Hand block-printed cotton from Rajasthan paired with breezy palazzos. The everyday hero of Indian summers.
tip: Wear a solid palazzo with a printed kurta (or the reverse) so the outfit has one focus.

name: Sharara Set
colourName: bottle green with antique gold embroidery
description: A short kurta over wide pants that flare from the knee. A favourite for Eid and wedding functions.
footwear: Embellished block heels (the flare needs a little height)
tip: Hem the sharara to just touch the floor with your heels on.

name: Gharara Set
colourName: rose pink with gold gota bands
description: Like a sharara but gathered at the knee with a decorative band. A Lucknowi classic with old-world charm.
pieces: Gharara pants with gota knee band
tip: The knee band is the signature, so keep the kurta short enough to show it.

name: Patiala Salwar Suit
colourName: fuchsia kurta with lime patiala and a marigold dupatta
description: Punjab’s pleated, voluminous salwar with a short kurta and a bright phulkari-style dupatta.
accessories: Paranda in the braid, chunky silver earrings
tip: Three bold colours work here because the patiala is so traditional. Keep them all equally bright.

name: Haldi Gota Kurta Set
colourName: turmeric yellow with gold gota lace
description: Sunny yellow cotton with shiny gota lace. Made for the haldi ceremony and fine to stain.
pieces: Sleeveless yellow kurta with gota trim
tip: Rent or buy budget for this one. Turmeric rarely washes out completely.

name: Half Saree (Langa Voni)
colourName: parrot green silk skirt with a pink voni and gold border
description: South India’s pattu pavadai with a draped half-saree (voni). Youthful and traditional.
accessories: Temple jewellery, oddiyanam waist belt, jasmine
tip: Match the voni to the blouse and let the skirt be the contrast.

name: Mekhela Chador
colourName: golden muga silk with red woven motifs
description: Assam’s two-piece drape in muga or pat silk: a wrapped skirt (mekhela) and a chador across the shoulder.
accessories: Jonbiri and dugdugi necklaces, gamkharu bangles
tip: Wear it for Bihu with red-and-gold jewellery for the most authentic look.

name: Dhoti Pants & Short Kurta
colourName: teal ikat kurta with ivory dhoti pants
description: Draped dhoti pants with a short kurta. Relaxed, playful and easy to move in.
tip: Keep the kurta above mid-thigh so the drape of the dhoti shows.

name: Cape Lehenga Set
colourName: ivory and champagne with gold sequins and a sheer cape
description: A lehenga skirt and bustier finished with a sheer embellished cape instead of a dupatta. Modern and hands-free.
pieces: Sheer ivory cape with gold border
tip: The cape replaces the dupatta. Never wear both.

name: Saree Gown
colourName: deep teal gown with a sheer aqua pallu and gold edging
description: A gown with an attached pallu: the grace of a saree with the ease of a dress. Loved at receptions abroad and in India.
pieces: Teal saree gown with attached drape
tip: Ideal if you love sarees but not draping. Pin the pallu at the shoulder for security.

name: Dhoti Pants, Crop & Long Jacket
colourName: black crop and dhoti pants under a gold brocade jacket
description: Black dhoti pants and crop top under a long brocade waistcoat. Sharp and dance-floor ready.
tip: Belt the jacket at the waist to show your shape.

name: Short Kurta with Jeans
colourName: magenta block-print kurti with blue jeans
description: The college staple: a short printed kurti over straight or skinny jeans.
tip: Roll the jeans once at the ankle to show off your footwear.

name: Printed Crop Top & Flared Skirt
colourName: orange ikat crop top and matching flared midi skirt
description: A matching crop top and flared skirt in an Indian print. Works for college fests and Diwali parties alike.
tip: Show only a sliver of midriff for a festive-friendly look.

name: Ikat Co-ord Set
colourName: indigo and white ikat crop top with matching wide pants
description: A handwoven ikat top and wide pants in one print. One decision, a complete outfit.
tip: Swap the top for a white tee on lazy days to get two outfits from one set.

name: Embroidered Kaftan
colourName: coral kaftan with gold embroidered hem
description: A loose, flowing kaftan that suits Eid lunches, resort holidays and lazy brunches.
tip: Belt it loosely if you want more shape.

name: Draped Skirt & Sheer Shrug
colourName: plum draped skirt with a lilac embellished blouse and long shrug
description: An embellished fitted blouse and draped skirt finished with a floor-length shrug. Glamorous but not heavy.
tip: Keep the blouse fitted so the long shrug falls in a clean line.

name: Belted Saree with Shirt Blouse
colourName: burnt orange saree with a white shirt blouse and a brown leather belt
description: A plain saree worn with a crisp full-sleeve shirt and a waist belt. Modern and office-party ready.
tip: Belt over the pallu at the waist to hold everything neatly in place.

name: The Little Black Dress
colourName: black sheath dress
description: Coco Chanel’s timeless idea: a simple black dress you can dress up or down.
accessories: Gold hoops, a structured mini bag
tip: Change the accessories and it goes from office dinner to party.

name: Power Pantsuit
colourName: navy tailored suit with a blush silk top
description: A tailored blazer and matching trousers. The most confident outfit for interviews and presentations.
accessories: Small studs, a slim watch, a structured tote
tip: Get the blazer shoulders tailored. Shoulder fit is the one thing a tailor cannot easily fix later.

name: Pencil Skirt & Silk Blouse
colourName: ivory silk blouse with a charcoal pencil skirt
description: A tucked silk blouse with a knee-length pencil skirt. Polished and feminine.
tip: Choose a skirt with a back slit so you can walk comfortably.

name: Wrap Dress
colourName: emerald floral wrap dress
description: Diane von Furstenberg’s 1974 classic: ties at the waist and flatters nearly every body type.
tip: Wear a camisole underneath if the neckline sits too low for work.

name: Floral Sundress
colourName: sunshine yellow sundress with white and coral flowers
description: Light cotton with thin straps and a cheerful print. Pure summer.
tip: Add a denim jacket for evenings or air-conditioned cafés.

name: Boho Tiered Maxi
colourName: rust tiered maxi dress
description: A flowing tiered maxi in earthy rust. Effortless for holidays, hill stations and festivals.
tip: Cinch it with a skinny tan belt to keep the volume from overwhelming you.

name: Smart-casual Denim & Blazer
colourName: white tee, mid-blue jeans and a camel blazer
description: A white tee and straight jeans with a blazer thrown on top. The smartest casual outfit there is.
tip: Push the blazer sleeves up slightly to keep it relaxed.

name: Graphic Tee & Straight Jeans
colourName: red graphic tee with dark straight jeans
description: The default weekend outfit. Simple, comfortable and easy to personalise.
tip: Half-tuck the tee at the front to define your waist.

name: Wide-leg Jumpsuit
colourName: cobalt blue halter jumpsuit with a gold belt
description: One piece, wide legs, instant glamour. Works from boardroom to dinner with a change of shoes.
tip: Make sure the crotch length is right. A jumpsuit that pulls is never comfortable.

name: Satin Slip Dress
colourName: champagne satin bias-cut slip dress
description: A 90s minimalist favourite. Bias-cut satin that skims the body.
accessories: Fine gold chain, a small shoulder bag
tip: Steam, never iron, satin. Layer a blazer over it for cooler nights.

name: Sequin Mermaid Gown
colourName: midnight blue sequin mermaid gown
description: Fitted through the hips and flaring at the knee. The red-carpet silhouette.
tip: Practise walking and sitting in it before the event.

name: Bodycon Mini Dress
colourName: hot pink bodycon mini
description: Stretchy, close-fitting and short. Made for a night out.
footwear: Yellow strappy heels or chunky boots
tip: Choose a thick, structured knit so it holds shape and is not see-through.

name: Monochrome Co-ord
colourName: lilac matching top and wide trousers
description: Top and trousers in the same colour. Looks put together with zero effort.
tip: Same colour, different textures (knit with linen, say) makes it look expensive.

name: Trench Coat Layering
colourName: camel trench coat over a cream knit and dark jeans
description: A belted camel trench over jeans and a knit. The classic for London, Paris or a Delhi winter.
tip: Tie the belt at the back when you wear it open.

name: Athleisure Set
colourName: coral crop hoodie with charcoal joggers
description: A cropped hoodie and joggers. Comfortable enough for a long flight, smart enough for a coffee run.
tip: Matching sets look more intentional than random gym clothes.

name: Pleated Midi & Knit
colourName: cream knit with a mocha pleated midi skirt
description: A soft knit tucked into a pleated midi. The polished Korean-minimal look.
tip: Tuck only the front of the knit to keep the waist visible without bulk.

name: Silver Sequin Mini
colourName: silver sequin long-sleeve mini dress
description: Long sleeves balance the short hem. The New Year’s Eve dress.
accessories: Very minimal: the dress is the jewellery
tip: Long sleeves plus a short hem looks more polished than a short and strappy combo.

name: Off-shoulder Top & Flares
colourName: white ruffled off-shoulder top with red flared trousers
description: A ruffled off-shoulder top with high-waisted flared trousers. Retro and flattering.
tip: Show off the collarbones: skip the necklace and go for bold earrings.

name: Belted Shirt Dress
colourName: blue and white striped shirt dress with a brown belt
description: A button-down shirt stretched into a dress. Crisp and grown-up.
tip: Unbutton the bottom two buttons for easier walking.
